role: Strongly-typed string identifier wrappers for knowledge graph and tracing
detail: Defines three NewType-based identifier types used across the Co-Being system. NodeId: unique identifier for knowledge graph nodes; EdgeId: unique identifier for graph edges/relationships; CorrelationId: tracing identifier (typically UUID4) for following operations across components. All wrap str at runtime (zero overhead) but are distinct types at type-check time, preventing accidental type confusion. No constants, algorithms, or side effects - purely type definitions used by graph layer, perception, and logging infrastructure.
